title: IDOR in Appointment Routes - GET /appointments/:id
description: The GET /api/v1/appointments/:id endpoint in the vulnerable API lacks any ownership validation. Any authenticated user (CUSTOMER, BARBER, or ADMIN) can access any appointment by simply providing its ID in the URL path. The vulnerable implementation directly calls getAppointment.execute with the provided ID without verifying that the requesting user owns or is associated with the appointment.
impact: Cross-customer appointment data exfiltration. A malicious customer can enumerate and access appointment details (date, time, service, barber, status, notes) belonging to other customers by simply enumerating or guessing appointment IDs.
mitigation: Implement ownership validation middleware (checkAppointmentAccess) that verifies the requesting user is either the appointment's customer (customerId matches userId), the assigned barber (barberId matches userId), or an ADMIN. Compare with secure implementation in appointment_routes_secure.md which uses checkAppointmentAccess middleware.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for IDOR in GET /appointments/:id endpoint
